title: Generated web JSON of one profile series (generated/web/<SERIES>.json)
description: Every property has a status. `supported`: numeric value and approved method id. `unsupported`: value null and method null. The allOf rules enforce value null <=> status unsupported for every property of every profile, the corner-radius rule for SHS/RHS, and the convention methods registered for each shape.

schema_version.description: Version of this web JSON contract. Incremented with every change of this schema other than its descriptions and with every change of the index.json layout (docs/CONVENTIONS.md).

corner_radii.description: Series rule for the corner radii of SHS/RHS (see docs/DATA_MODEL.md); the resolved ro/ri are in each profile's geometry.

units.description: Units of the values: every geometry key is a length in mm except slope_pct (the slope of sloped flanges, 100·tan α, in %); properties as listed (alpha: the angle of the principal axis u in degrees).

properties_meta.description: Status per property. A supported convention-dependent property (It, Wt, Iw, ym) must name a method registered for the shape.
